user.title: Add an IR television
user.description: Give this TV a name and the manufacturer shown in Home Assistant / HomeKit Accessory Information. You will map power, volume, playback, and sources in the next steps. Each command can be an IR remote (`remote.send_command`, Broadlink or Logitech Harmony Hub) or a Home Assistant button (`button.press`).

data_description.manufacturer: Shown as the device manufacturer (生产企业). HomeKit Accessory Information uses this field. Default is IR Television.
